text: @nillionnetwork 's nilCC lets developers run any Docker Compose application inside Trusted Execution Environments, with hardware-level isolation via AMD SEV-SNP . According to Arkham Intelligence, a wallet linked to convicted Irish drug dealer Clifton Collins transferred 500 $BTC to Coinbase Prime on October 20. Collins reportedly accumulated 6,000 BTC between 2011 and 2012, but the private keys were believed lost after being hidden inside a fishing rod case. For years, those coins were considered inaccessible. Now, things have changed. 🔹 500 BTC moved in the latest transaction. 🔹 2,500 BTC have moved from Collins-linked wallets in 2026. 🔹 Approximately 3,500 BTC remain, worth around $288 million. Irish authorities have previously recovered Bitcoin connected to the case, although the party responsible for this latest transfer has not been officially confirmed. text: 🚨 JPMorgan now projects Bitcoin could outperform US stocks and gold over the next decade. For the first time, JPMorgan Asset Management has included $BTC in its long-term return assumptions. Its base case projects 10% annualized returns over the next 10–15 years. 📊 How Bitcoin compares: ₿ Bitcoin: 10.0% annually 🇺🇸 US Stocks: 7.5% 📈 Private Equity: 9.8% 🏦 US Bonds: 5.6% 🥇 Gold: 5.5% At a starting price of $83,000, a 10% compounded annual return would put Bitcoin near $215,000 in 10 years. That’s approximately 159% upside under the modeled scenario. But JPMorgan also highlights Bitcoin’s significant volatility. These are long-term assumptions, not guaranteed returns or official price targets. Still, seeing a major Wall Street institution model Bitcoin alongside traditional asset classes is a notable development. Do you think $BTC will outperform stocks and gold over the next decade? #Bitc

creator: Cas Abbé
text: One thing that makes #Polymarket different is that the rules matter as much as the probability. Before taking a position, you can check exactly what source will determine the outcome, when the market ends, and how edge cases are handled. The title may look simple, but the resolution rules define what actually counts. And once the event is resolved, the winning shares settle at $1 while losing shares become worthless. Resolution is handled through UMA’s Optimistic Oracle. So the real research isn’t just: “What do I think will happen?” It’s also: “What exactly am I trading, and how will it be resolved?” That’s an important part of understanding prediction markets. Not financial advice. @polymarket #btc

Along with the Intercontinental Exchange, crypto exchange OKX was the first to file with the regulator to debut tokenized securities trading on a new platform, OKXICE. The SEC in September said it was offering a five-year exemption to platforms that facilitate trading of tokenized stocks. Regulators like the SEC are pushing ahead with regulating the crypto space despite lawmakers blocking major digital asset legislation in September. - © Bitcoin Magazine

text: Searching hard enough through random data will always produce a winner. The out-of-sample test is the only thing that tells you whether you found an edge or just found noise wearing a costume. Three survivors out of 40 is roughly what pure chance produces at that sample size. text: Any strategy must clear 0.240% of position size per trade just to break even. Most published setups never mention this number, which is why most published setups lose money. Here is what that came from. I measured real execution costs with 48 controlled trades. One number decides everything. I stopped assuming what trading costs and measured it: 48 controlled round trips, entering and exiting immediately, recording the actual fill against the reference price. Fee was constant at 0.04% per side. Slippage was not - ETH filled at essentially zero, while DOGE cost 50 to 100 basis points per round trip. On a 150 USDT position, a round trip costs 0.36 USDT before the market moves at all. text: HOW I TESTED IT Collecting funding on perpetuals is sold as passive yield. I pulled 34,431 funding events across 7 symbols and measured it. Average funding is 0.0024% per 8-hour period. On a 150 USDT position that is 0.0036 USDT. A round trip costs 0.36 USDT - you would hold for 33 days just to cover entry and exit. Meanwhile the price moves 2.36% in a typical 8 hours. THE NUMBERS Mean funding per 8h: 0.0024% Annualised: 2.6% 8h price volatility: 2.36% Periods to cover costs: 100 The income is real but tiny, and the price risk you take to earn it is roughly a thousand times larger. This is why desks that trade it hedge with spot. Unhedged, it is not income - it is a directional bet with a rebate. text: Everyone in crypto seems to be looking for the next opportunity. Some people chase airdrops, others search for free tokens, and many spend hours completing tasks in the hope of receiving rewards. But here's something I believe deserves more attention: what if learning about cryptocurrency for free is actually more valuable than chasing small rewards? The crypto industry moves incredibly fast. text: Volatility is a blessing for a trader. The market brings new opportunities every single day. All you have to do is find the right coin where most of the trading activity is happening and where the volume is flowing. Once you find it, prepare your trade plan. Decide whether you’re looking for a long or a short, and then wait for your setup to play out. No need to rush, no need to force anything. Trading is simple when you approach it this way. text: We manage risks every single day, often without realizing it. From driving a car to making long-term plans about health or insurance, risk assessment is something humans do almost instinctively. But when it comes to financial markets, especially trading, risk management becomes a conscious and decisive factor that separates those who survive from those who don’t. In trading, most losses don’t come from not knowing indicators. They come from poor reactions to risk. A trader can lose money simply because the market moves against their position, but more often, losses are amplified when emotions take over. Panic selling, revenge trading, or abandoning a plan halfway through a trade are patterns that wipe accounts far faster than any bad entry.
